project.title: Boy at the Computer (2000 -> 2030)
project.logline: A boy who loves computer games in year-2000 Malaysia grows into a man trapped by one in 2030.

Text overlay "2000" in a retro pixel font in the corner. A Malaysian Chinese teenage boy (16, round face, short black hair, small mole above the left eyebrow, casual t-shirt) sits in a cramped living room in front of a bulky beige CRT desktop computer with a chunky keyboard, Windows 98 on screen. Medium shot, then a slow push-in. He smiles happily, absorbed in the game, lit by the screen glow.

motion.video_prompt: Realistic live-action, Malaysia, 16:9, slow pacing, 8 seconds. Start from a glowing screen that fades into a cold, desaturated blue-grey look. Text overlay "2030" in a clean modern font. A dim open-plan office at night, flat fluorescent lighting, empty desks, cold coffee cups, wall clock showing 11:47 PM. A Malaysian Chinese man (40, round face, short black hair, small mole above the left eyebrow, wrinkled shirt, loosened tie) sits at a desktop with dual monitors full of spreadsheets, dark eye bags, red tired eyes. He rubs his face with both hands. Man (Malaysian English, low weary voice): "Haiz... so late already, still cannot go home. Every day sit here with this computer." He glances at the bag by his chair, starts to stand, then the screen pings "URGENT: DEADLINE 8AM". His face drops, he sighs and sits back down to type. Slow zoom out to a tiny figure in a huge empty office. Soft sad piano music.

assets.prompt_override: Modern Malaysian open-plan office at night in the year 2030: a large floor plate with a grid of identical desks, most chairs pushed in and empty, glass partition walls, grey carpet, laminated desks, brushed metal. Flat cold fluorescent lighting, everything desaturated blue-grey. One single desk in the middle distance still lit by dual flat-panel monitors full of spreadsheets, next to it a cold coffee cup and a crumpled shirt sleeve over the chair. A wall clock deep in the background shows 11:47 PM. A green emergency exit sign glows at the far end. No people anywhere. Cold, lonely, contemporary corporate mood.
